svg.text: tokprof bench · requests priced at their time · the compaction call is not logged: modeled as writing the cold context again plus a 10k-token summary
heartbeats: a ping at 5/6 of the cache lifetime, every 50m on a 1h cache, for up to 6h after the last request; a return within the last ping's lifetime reads the cache
heartbeats, then compaction: the same pings, then at the next ping time past 6h a compaction that reads the warm context; a later return starts from what it leaves
